activated.comment: The extension started in a window, with the settings that turn features on and off.

set.*.comment: Each impactTree enum setting as one of its own values (or other), each boolean setting, reachDepth, and whether githubRemote and baseBranch are set (never their text).

command.used.comment: The first run of one of our commands in a window; later runs in that window are not sent.

command.comment: The command's id without the impactTree. prefix, from the extension's own list.

analysis.finished.comment: A review finished. Counts only: no file, symbol or repository names.

mode.comment: The diff mode, such as pr or checkpoint.

lang.*.comment: Changed symbols per language: ts, js, go, py, java or other.

agent.handoff.comment: Analyse with my agent handed the review to an agent.

agent.comment: Which agent, from the extension's fixed list.

agent.submitted.comment: An agent sent a result back. Never its content.

kind.comment: The kind of result, from the extension's fixed list.

client.comment: The MCP client that sent it, as a word from a fixed list (claude-code, cursor, codex, …), other or unknown.

model.comment: The model the agent says it is, as a family from a fixed list (claude-opus, gpt, gemini, …), other or unknown. Never the id as written.

modelVersion.comment: The first version number in the model id, digits and dots only (5.5).

toolCalls.comment: Impact Tree tools the agent called before it submitted.

handedOver.comment: Whether the user handed the review over from the editor (Analyse with my agent) and was waiting for it.

notes.comment: Cards answers: changes the agent described.

changed.comment: Cards answers: notes of kind changed.

mayChange.comment: Cards answers: notes of kind may-change.

same.comment: Cards answers: notes of kind same.

new.comment: Cards answers: notes of kind new.

shapes.comment: Cards answers: notes with a pseudocode diff.

attention.comment: Cards answers: changes in needs your attention.

feedback.sent.comment: A feedback round was saved and handed to an agent. Never its text.

agent.comment: Which agent, from the extension's fixed list.

starPrompt.answered.comment: The one-time request to star the repository on GitHub was answered or closed.

$exception.comment: An error. Its type, where it happened and Impact Tree's own stack frames; never the error message.

source.comment: For an analysis error: local, checkout or pr.
